claim: source unit creation: create_source_unit requires an existing project
source unit creation schema: create_source_unit requires a non-draft schema version of the project (_require_usable_schema)
source unit initial status: _persist_source_unit stores status ready
source unit blank external_ref: _persist_source_unit turns a blank external_ref into None
bulk source unit creation schema: bulk_create_source_units defaults to the project's active schema
bulk source unit duplicate: bulk_create_source_units marks an item duplicate when its external_ref exists in the project
bulk source unit duplicate: bulk_create_source_units marks an item duplicate when its external_ref occurs earlier in the request
single source unit duplicate check: single create of a source unit has no duplicate check
segmentation strategy lookup: generate_segments resolves the strategy by casefolded name (paragraphs, isnad)
segmentation strategy unknown name: generate_segments raises RuleViolationError
segment numbering: generate_segments numbers segments from 1
segment strategy metadata: generate_segments stamps metadata_json["strategy"] on segments
re-segmentation: generate_segments replaces the source unit's existing segments
paragraph segmentation: ParagraphSegmentation.split cuts on blank lines
paragraph segmentation fallback: ParagraphSegmentation.split falls back from blank-line cuts to non-empty lines
paragraph segmentation last fallback: ParagraphSegmentation.split falls back from non-empty lines to the whole stripped text
isnad segmentation: IsnadSegmentation.split emits one segment per chain from segment_isnad
isnad segment metadata: IsnadSegmentation.split sets chain_no, start_offset, end_offset
isnad segmentation matn boundary: IsnadSegmentation.split skips chains starting at or after the matn boundary
isnad segmentation fallback: IsnadSegmentation.split falls back to the whole text (fallback: whole_text)
segment reuse: _ensure_segments reuses segments already cut with the requested strategy
segmentation strategy default: _ensure_segments takes the strategy from the request, else the project template, else paragraphs
LLM provider registration: the container always registers NoOpLLMProvider (noop)
LLM provider registration: the container always registers RuleBasedIsnadProvider (rule_based_isnad)
LLM provider registration: the container registers OpenAILLMProvider only with a non-blank API key
LLM provider registration: the container registers AnthropicLLMProvider only with a non-blank API key
LLM provider registration: CachedLLMProvider is not registered in the container
extraction provider and model: come from the run, else default_llm_provider / default_llm_model
extraction unregistered provider: an unregistered LLM provider raises RuleViolationError
extraction unregistered prompt version: an unregistered prompt version raises RuleViolationError
extraction prompt name: the extraction prompt is candidate_graph_extraction
default prompt version: candidate_graph_extraction_v2
prompt version v1: candidate_graph_extraction v1 demands exact case-sensitive type names
prompt version v2: candidate_graph_extraction v2 accepts type names or aliases case-insensitively
prompt payload run ids: _build_prompt_payload sends run ids to the model
prompt payload source unit: _build_prompt_payload sends source-unit metadata (title, external_ref, …)
prompt payload schema: _build_prompt_payload sends the whole schema to the model
prompt payload schema parts: merge keys, thresholds, aliases, extraction_hints, property definitions (_build_prompt_payload)
prompt payload segments: _build_prompt_payload sends each segment's segment_id, segment_order, text
prompt payload raw_content: _build_prompt_payload does not send raw_content to the model

one_call_per_segment strategy: the isnad segmentation strategy sets one_call_per_segment for _plan_calls
extraction call chunking: without one_call_per_segment, _plan_calls issues chunks of max_segments_per_call

OpenAI request endpoint: OpenAI receives /chat/completions
OpenAI request temperature: the /chat/completions request has temperature 0
OpenAI request response_format: the /chat/completions request has response_format json_object
Anthropic request: Anthropic receives messages.create with JSON schema EXTRACTION_WIRE_SCHEMA
Anthropic request properties: the Anthropic messages.create request carries properties as name/value lists
Anthropic request merge_key_payload: the Anthropic messages.create request has no merge_key_payload
rule-based isnad provider prompt: RuleBasedIsnadProvider ignores the prompt
rule-based isnad provider parsing: RuleBasedIsnadProvider runs segment_isnad
rule-based isnad provider output: RuleBasedIsnadProvider returns Narrator nodes and NARRATED_FROM relations
rule-based isnad provider confidence: RuleBasedIsnadProvider returns its nodes and relations at confidence 0.95
model output validation: _normalize_output validates against StructuredExtractionContract
model output extra fields: StructuredExtractionContract ignores extra fields
model output confidence range: StructuredExtractionContract requires confidence 0–1
model output validation error: in _normalize_output a ValidationError becomes RuleViolationError
unknown type in model output: a node or relation whose type is unknown by casefolded name or alias is dropped
undefined type proposal: a dropped unknown-type node or relation is recorded as a SchemaProposal (schema_type_proposal)
relation with dropped endpoint: model-output relations with a dropped endpoint are dropped too
undeclared properties: _keep_declared_properties strips properties not declared on the type
undeclared property proposal: _keep_declared_properties records schema_property_proposal with a sample value
undeclared properties candidate: _keep_declared_properties keeps the candidate whose properties were stripped
extraction call failure: a duplicate node ref fails the call with RuleViolationError
extraction call failure: a relation with an unknown ref fails the call with RuleViolationError
extraction call failure: endpoint types differing from the relation type's from_type/to_type fail the call (RuleViolationError)
extraction call error isolation: a RuleViolationError or ExternalServiceError fails only that call (FailedExtractionCall)
Anthropic error kinds: ExternalServiceError from Anthropic has kinds refusal, max_tokens, invalid_output, …
extraction partial failure: the execution still ends succeeded with error_message set, unless every call failed
extraction exception: any exception leaving extract_candidates marks the ExtractionExecution failed
extraction exception after start: an exception leaving extract_candidates marks the run and source unit failed, once started
extraction persistence: non-dry extraction runs persist candidates
schema proposal review item: non-dry extraction runs upsert one schema_proposal review item per proposal
schema proposal review item reopen: a closed schema_proposal review item is not reopened by extraction
extraction dry_run: dry_run persists only the execution row
extraction with existing candidates: existing candidates raise ConflictError
validation of completed runs: validate_run refuses completed runs
validation order: validate_run validates nodes, then relations, then applies duplicate resolution
human decision precedence in validation: the latest human ReviewDecision outranks the validation rules
human decision candidate status: latest ReviewDecision reject gives rejected, anything else validated
human decision rule code: a status set by the latest human ReviewDecision is recorded as human_review_decision
node rejection rules: nodes are rejected for node_type_exists, required_node_property, node_merge_key
node merge key payload: derive_merge_key_payload re-derives the payload, property values overriding supplied ones
node review status: nodes go to review on evidence, grounding or enum findings
node confidence threshold: nodes go to review on node_confidence_threshold (below the type's confidence_threshold)
node validated status: a node neither rejected nor sent to review is validated (candidate_node_valid)
relation rejection rules: rejected for relation_type_exists, relation_candidate_refs, relation_from_type, relation_to_type
relation rejection rules: relations are rejected for required_relation_property
relation with rejected endpoint: relations are rejected for relation_dependency_rejected (rejected endpoint)
relation review status: relations go to review for evidence or enum findings
relation review rules: review for missing_relation_merge_key, relation_dependency_review, relation_confidence_threshold
relation validated status: a relation neither rejected nor sent to review is validated (candidate_relation_valid)
enum value check: _enum_findings raises property_value_not_allowed only for string values with enum_values
data_type check: no validation rule checks property values against data_type
evidence reference fields: EvidenceRef holds segment_id, quote, start_offset, end_offset
evidence segment check at extraction: extraction fails the call when an evidence segment_id was not sent in that call
evidence segment check in candidate API: the candidate API rejects evidence segments of another source unit
grounding precondition: applies only when the run has a succeeded non-dry-run extraction execution (_grounding_segments)
grounding skipped: runs without a succeeded non-dry-run extraction execution get no evidence findings
missing evidence check: _evidence_findings gives missing_evidence for a candidate without evidence refs
evidence quote check: _evidence_findings gives quote_not_in_segment per evidence ref whose quote is empty
evidence quote check: _evidence_findings gives quote_not_in_segment per evidence ref whose segment is unknown
evidence quote check: _evidence_findings gives quote_not_in_segment when the quote is not a substring of the segment text
merge key grounding scope: _merge_key_grounding_findings applies to nodes only
merge key grounding: _merge_key_grounding_findings gives value_not_in_quote per string merge-key value absent from every quote
merge key grounding exception: no value_not_in_quote when the value equals the cited source unit's external_ref
property grounding: properties other than merge keys are unchecked by _merge_key_grounding_findings
grounding text matching: evidence and merge-key matching uses normalize_for_grounding
grounding normalization order: normalize_for_grounding applies normalize_text then normalize_arabic
text normalization: normalize_text applies NFKC, whitespace collapse, casefold
Arabic normalization: normalize_arabic removes diacritics and turns punctuation to spaces
Arabic normalization letters: normalize_arabic folds alef/hamza forms, ى and ة
evidence offset check: there is no check of evidence start_offset/end_offset
evidence fields read: _evidence_findings reads only segment_id and quote
node identity key: build_candidate_node_resolution_key is normalised type + :: + JSON of the normalised merge_key_payload
node identity normalisation: build_candidate_node_resolution_key uses NFKC, whitespace collapse, casefold
node identity matching: build_candidate_node_resolution_key keys match exactly, with no Arabic folding
cross-call node merge: _absorb_call folds a node into an earlier call's node with the same identity (all merge keys present)
cross-call node merge evidence: _absorb_call appends the folded node's evidence
cross-call node merge confidence: _absorb_call maximises confidence of the folded nodes
cross-call node merge relations: _absorb_call re-points relations to the earlier call's node
same-call node merge: nodes within one extraction call are not merged by _absorb_call
duplicate node detection: _flag_duplicate_candidate_nodes groups non-rejected nodes with a merge payload
duplicate node primary: the group primary is human-decided, then highest confidence, then lowest id
duplicate node status: other undecided members of a duplicate node group become review (potential_duplicate_node)
relation identity key: build_candidate_relation_resolution_key is type, both endpoint keys and build_relation_identity_key
relation identity hash: build_relation_identity_key is SHA-256 of the relation type's merge-key properties
relation identity without merge keys: build_relation_identity_key is constant when no merge-key properties are declared
duplicate relation detection: _flag_duplicate_candidate_relations skips rejected relations
duplicate relation detection: _flag_duplicate_candidate_relations skips relations missing a merge-key value
duplicate relation status: non-primary members of a duplicate relation group become review (potential_duplicate_relation)
canonical node key: build_canonical_merge_key is SHA-256 of the normalised payload
canonical node key empty payload: build_canonical_merge_key is SHA-256 of the candidate id when the payload is empty
canonical match annotation: _annotate_canonical_matches adds only info results canonical_node_match / canonical_relation_match
review item rebuild: validation rebuilds review items
review item rebuild kept items: schema_proposal review items are kept when validation rebuilds review items
review item rebuild kept items: human-decided review items are kept when validation rebuilds review items
review item creation: each candidate in review gets one open review item
review item reason_code: the candidate's first review rule (fallback candidate_review)
review decision actions: decide_review_item takes accept, reject or edit
review decision reviewer: decide_review_item requires reviewer_id
review decision on completed run: decide_review_item raises ConflictError once the run is completed
review decision record: each decision is appended as a ReviewDecision (reviewer_id, reviewer_note, duration_ms)
review decision before/after: ReviewDecision carries before_json/after_json only for edit
review item status after decision: the review item becomes accepted, rejected or edited
node edit in review: node edit may replace node_type, properties, merge_key_payload, confidence
node accept and edit checks: re-check type, required properties, merge keys, relation compatibility and uniqueness
node accept or edit check failure: RuleViolationError and nothing is saved
relation edit in review: relation edit may change type, endpoints, properties, confidence
relation accept and edit checks: require both endpoint nodes validated
relation accept and edit checks: require matching types, required properties and all merge keys
schema_proposal review item actions: a schema_proposal item can only be accepted or rejected
schema proposal decision: decide_review_item records the decision and does not change the schema
relation review refresh: _refresh_relation_reviews_for_run rejects undecided relations with a rejected endpoint
relation_dependency_review auto-accept: _refresh_relation_reviews_for_run accepts an open item once both endpoints are validated
relation_dependency_review auto-accept exception: no auto-accept when _pending_relation_review finds another reason
acceptance records: list_acceptance_records returns one record per validated candidate
acceptance record content: list_acceptance_records gives the latest accepting decision or policy auto_validated
commit twice: commit_run raises ConflictError if the run already has a graph delta
commit with pending candidate: commit_run raises RuleViolationError for a pending candidate
commit with open review item: commit_run raises RuleViolationError for an open review item (schema proposals included)
commit relation endpoint: commit_run raises RuleViolationError for a validated relation with a non-validated endpoint
commit candidate statuses: only validated candidates are written to the graph
commit rejected_count: rejected_count counts rejected candidates
commit review_count: review_count is always 0
candidate status committed: CandidateStatus.COMMITTED is never assigned
commit relation identity: _build_relation_identity_keys refuses a missing merge-key value
commit conflict: _build_relation_identity_keys refuses two validated relations sharing an identity with different properties
Neo4j commit transaction: Neo4jCanonicalGraphRepository.commit_bundle writes the run in one session.execute_write transaction
Neo4j lookup indexes: ensured before the Neo4jCanonicalGraphRepository.commit_bundle transaction

Neo4j node SET after MERGE: SET n += properties, source_unit_id, last_run_id, updated_at
Neo4j node created_at: created_at is set only on create
Neo4j node property overwrite: a later commit overwrites same-named properties of a merged node

Neo4j provenance source: SourceUnit HAS_SEGMENT Segment
Neo4j SourceUnit raw_content: the provenance SourceUnit is written without raw_content
Neo4j node provenance edges: DERIVED_FROM and SUPPORTED_BY carrying run_id, candidate_ref
Neo4j relation provenance: RelationEvidence {candidate_relation_id} with FROM_NODE, TO_NODE, DERIVED_FROM, SUPPORTED_BY
Neo4j commit summary: GraphDelta with counters is written as provenance
Neo4j evidence quotes: evidence quotes are not written to Neo4j
Postgres commit order: Postgres follows the Neo4j transaction
Postgres graph_deltas: commit writes a graph_deltas row, unique per run
status after commit: run completed, source unit processed
Neo4j commit error: a Neo4j error marks both the run and the source unit failed
schema version number: create_schema_version requires a unique version_no (ConflictError)
schema version initial status: create_schema_version starts the version as draft
pipeline definition v1: create_schema_version adds it, chaining extract_candidates → validate_run → commit_run
schema type addition: types can be added only to draft schema versions
schema activation: activate_schema_version sets the target version active
schema activation previous version: activate_schema_version demotes the previous active version to published
schema version status retired: nothing assigns retired
node type fields: name, display_name, merge_keys, confidence_threshold, aliases, extraction_hints, properties
node type confidence threshold: node types have confidence_threshold (0.5)
node type name uniqueness: node type names are unique case-insensitively
node merge_keys validation: node merge_keys are not checked against declared properties
relation type fields: from_type/to_type, required_properties, merge_keys, confidence_threshold, directional
relation type endpoints: from_type/to_type must exist in the schema version
relation type merge_keys: relation merge_keys must be declared properties
relation type confidence threshold: relation types have confidence_threshold (0.7)
property definition fields: name, data_type, required, default_value, enum_values
identifier naming: type and property names must match IDENTIFIER_PATTERN
project templates: templates are blank, story, isnad
isnad template node types: Narrator (key name), Hadith (key hadith_ref)
isnad template relation NARRATED_FROM: keys hadith_ref, chain_no, position
isnad template relation TRANSMITS: the isnad template defines TRANSMITS
isnad template segmentation strategy: the isnad template sets strategy isnad
project creation from template: ProjectSetupService.create_project with apply_template_schema creates the next schema version
project creation from template: ProjectSetupService.create_project activates the schema version created from the template
template without schema: ProjectSetupService.create_project adds no schema version for a template without a schema
run start rejection: start_processing_run rejects a draft or processing source unit
run start schema mismatch: start_processing_run rejects a schema version differing from the source unit's
run start pipeline_version: start_processing_run rejects a pipeline_version without definition
run start status: start_processing_run starts the run pending and the source unit becomes processing
run status lifecycle: pending → running → completed (unit processed) or failed (unit failed)
batch processing: process_source_units runs start, segmentation, extraction and validation per unit synchronously
batch processing commit: process_source_units commits only if commit is set and nothing is open
batch processing unit status: process_source_units reports status failed, needs_review, validated, committed
job enqueue on completed run: enqueue_job refuses completed runs
job enqueue duplicate: enqueue_job refuses a second active job of the same type (ConflictError)
job chaining source: chain_on_success comes from the request or the pipeline definition
job execution: process_next_job executes a claimed job, then enqueues its chained jobs and marks it succeeded
chained job enqueue: process_next_job enqueues chained jobs unconditionally, skipped only when one is active or succeeded
job failure: any exception in process_next_job marks the job failed
job failure example: commit_run on a run with open review items raises, so process_next_job marks the job failed
job retry: failed jobs are not retried
job claim order: Postgres claim_next takes the oldest pending job whose run has no running job
job claim locking: claim_next uses pg_try_advisory_xact_lock and FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
API routers: api_router mounts chains, commit, extraction, exploration, health, ingestion, pipeline-definition routers
API routers: api_router mounts pipeline, processing-job, project, review, schema and template routers
API error status codes: 404 NotFoundError, 409 ConflictError, 422 RuleViolationError, 502 ExternalServiceError
authentication: there is no authentication; api_router only aggregates the routers
reviewer identity: reviewer_id is whatever the caller sends
